structured.approach: I followed the frontend-steps FE-04 procedure. I read the contracted inputs: task.components, feat.design (section B4), feat.stories (the STORY-07 section with AC-07.1 to AC-07.10 and TK-07.1 to TK-07.5), feat.screens, org.design_library, org.lessons and org.engineering_stack. I then used the CodeGraph MCP tool (codegraph_explore with the repository projectPath) to read the current source of every changed symbol and its blast radius, and ran codegraph sync and codegraph affected on src/ap_portal/index.js. The code in the working tree implements FC-1 to FC-7 as the design and screens specify, so no source change was needed. CodeGraph reported no affected test files, because the tests import by package name through NODE_PATH, so I ran the full CI with node ci.mjs. CI compiles, both existing tests pass and there are no static issues. Only the coverage gate fails, which the owner has deferred to FE-05. I rewrote task.code.md in full. It quotes the CI result, marks the agent-judgement choices, hands the test list over to FE-05 and leaves the version step as a non-blocking question, because package.json is outside this step's write scope.
tools_used: Bash (git status, git diff, node ci.mjs, codegraph status/sync/callers/impact/affected)

claims.text: src/ap_portal/index.js adds RISK_CLASSES, OVERDUE_HEADINGS, the private helpers escapeHtml, toTwoDecimalString and riskClass, and the exported renderOverdueRisk. Existing lines are unchanged except module.exports.

renderOverdueRisk returns '' for undefined, null or []. It throws TypeError for a non-array rows value or a non-integer days. Otherwise it renders table.overdue-risk with the header Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue, Amount and one risk-* row per input row, in the given order.
Rows whose risk is high, medium, low or unknown get the classes risk-high, risk-medium, risk-low and risk-unknown, and any other risk value renders as risk-unknown.
Amounts are formatted only as strings and never pass through Number(), parseFloat or formatAmount, in line with D-2026-044 and L-011.
formatAmount, toTwoDecimalString and riskClass each have 1 caller in src/ap_portal/index.js.
The component emits only class hooks, with no tokens or inline styles, because the design library defines no tokens for the risk classes.
The CI computes passed only when line coverage is at least 90 and there are no static issues. The static checks flag console.log, eval( and lines longer than 140 characters.
The owner accepted FE-04 without the coverage gate. The new tests are written in FE-05, and the full CI, including the 90% gate, must pass before the commit step.
TK-07.5 asks for a package version step from 2.3.0 in index.js and package.json. package.json still holds 2.3.0 and is outside this step's write scope, so the step is deferred.
README.md and docs/ap_portal.md document renderOverdueRisk: signature, CT-1 input fields, output, errors, money and escaping rules, a synthetic example and the styling hooks.
The repository rule is to keep existing public signatures and add new functions for new behaviour.

open_questions: Q-1 (not blocking for FE-04; must be settled before FE-06): which step sets the next minor version in both src/ap_portal/index.js and package.json (DD-11, TK-07.5), given that package.json is outside FE-04's write scope, and who confirms the number? Owner: Developer.
Q-2 (carried from CQ-FE-1): should a missing or non-string id or vendor throw TypeError, as days and amount do, instead of rendering String(value)? Owner: Architect.
Q-3 (carried from CQ-FE-2): who styles overdue-risk and the risk-* classes, given that the design library defines no tokens for them? Owner: UX lead.
structured.summary: The STORY-07 code is in place, uncommitted, on feature/story in ap_portal. renderOverdueRisk and its private helpers in src/ap_portal/index.js match feat.design B4, the feat.stories AC-07 criteria and the feat.screens FS-1/FS-2 frames. README.md and the new docs/ap_portal.md document them. In node ci.mjs the code compiles, the 2 existing tests pass and there are no static issues. CI does not pass yet because coverage is below 90, a gate the owner moved to FE-05. task.code.md quotes the CI result and lists the tests FE-05 must add. The version step stays open (Q-1) because package.json is outside this step's write scope; both files remain at 2.3.0.
